name: feature.campaign-intel.agents
description: Campaign Intelligence agent pack — the Campaign Intelligence Analyst, a manifest agent whose tools are the registerFeatureAgentTool reads over the intel surface (budget-optimize, forecast, plan-budget, pacing, attribution). It answers natural-language budget + forecast questions ('how should I allocate my budget across platforms?') over the performance store, from the one chat. Read-only, org-scoped; recommends, the human decides.
author: OpenWOP App

agents.label: Campaign Intelligence Analyst
agents.description: Answers data-backed budget + performance questions over your campaign data — budget reallocation toward higher ROAS, creative-fatigue detection, outcome forecasts, goal-based budget planning, budget-pacing bands, and attribution — reading the performance store through org-scoped tools. Recommends; the human decides.
